full_prompt_en: A square dramatic oil portrait shows a dark-haired woman from the hips upward, standing with both hands set at her waist against a nearly black brown interior ground. She occupies the center and tilts her head to the upper right, directing her gaze away from the viewer with a resolute, distant expression. Black hair is gathered back in a loose low style, with a few glossy strands catching light around the crown and cheek. A long metallic earring hangs beside the visible ear. Warm light illuminates her pale olive face, nose, cheekbone, lips colored deep red, and the strong line of her neck and collarbones. The other side of the face turns into deeper brown shadow. Her fitted black dress has a low neckline edged with bright white ruffles and sleeves ending in similarly pale gathered cuffs. The black fabric carries broad painterly folds and a narrow belt at the waist, but much of the lower garment merges with the dark background. Her elbows project outward, creating a strong triangular stance; the light skin of her forearms appears beneath the ruffled cuffs. Behind her, dark brown vertical and horizontal strokes suggest a room wall or paneling without resolving into furniture. The background remains almost empty, allowing a few warm strokes around the shoulders to separate her silhouette. A concentrated upper-left light strikes the face, chest, and white fabric, leaving the outer sleeves, lower skirt, and corners in rich shadow. The paint is thick and angular in the clothing and background, while the facial planes are smoother but still visibly brushed. No readable text enters the image. The overall composition fixes attention on the illuminated upward-turned face and assertive pose, balancing sharp white ruffles and warm flesh against a broad envelope of black.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形戏剧化油画肖像描绘一位深发女子从臀部以上的站姿，双手扶在腰上，背景是近乎黑色的深棕室内色域。她占据中央，头向右上方仰转，目光离开观者，神情坚决而略显遥远。黑发松散地向后盘在低处，头顶和面颊周围几缕光亮发丝接住光。一只长金属耳环垂在可见耳朵旁。暖光照亮浅橄榄色面容、鼻子、颧骨、深红嘴唇以及有力的颈与锁骨线条。脸的另一侧转入更深的棕影。贴身黑裙有低领口，边缘是明亮的白色褶边，袖口也有同样浅色的收拢褶边。黑色织物带宽阔绘画性褶皱与腰间窄带，但下部衣料大多融入暗背景。两肘向外展开，形成强有力的三角姿态；白色袖褶下露出受光的前臂皮肤。身后，深棕色竖横笔触暗示室内墙面或板面，没有具体家具。背景几乎空置，仅有肩周几笔暖色把剪影分开。集中的左上方光照亮面容、胸前和白色布料，外围袖子、裙摆下部与角落留在丰厚阴影中。衣料与背景里的颜料厚重而有棱角，脸部平面较平滑，却仍可见笔刷。画中没有可读文字。整体构图把注意力固定在受光上扬的脸和坚定姿势上，以清楚白褶边与暖肤色平衡宽阔的黑暗包围。
style_prompt_en: The painting has a dramatic, loosely brushed oil finish with a concentrated warm focal light and large black-brown shadow masses. Warm olive flesh, muted amber, deep red, and sharp ivory accents emerge from charcoal and umber. Bright focal planes are smoother and more legible, while dark fabric and surrounding ground are built from broad angular strokes with edges that disappear into one another. High side light reveals small glossy highlights and pale gathered textures, then falls away quickly across the frame. A strong triangular central mass projects into generous dark negative space, its outer points making the pose graphic and stable. The overall effect is confident, sensual, and theatrical, with painterly darkness giving the highlights unusual force.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有戏剧化、笔触松动的油画完成面，集中暖色焦点光照在大片黑棕阴影中。暖橄榄色肤调、低调琥珀色、深红与锐利象牙白强调从炭色和深棕中浮现。明亮焦点平面较平滑、易读，深色织物与周围背景则由宽阔棱角笔触建立，边缘彼此消失。强侧光显出小片光滑高光和浅色收拢肌理，随后在画框中迅速衰减。一片强烈三角形中央色块伸入充足深色负空间，外伸的角让姿态呈图形感且稳定。整体效果自信、感性而富于戏剧性，绘画性黑暗让高光格外有力。
theme_en: A dark-haired woman in black with white ruffles, hands at her waist
theme_zh: 深发女子穿黑衣白褶边、双手扶腰
name: Fabian Perez
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
